why: image-size is only fixable by a framework major upgrade — expo@57 + react-native@0.72 — which is a migration, not a patch. It's BUILD-TIME tooling reached through metro/expo (image-size parser DoS), not a runtime path an external caller reaches. Tracked for the framework-upgrade work; the gate fails on anything NOT listed here. postcss/decode-uri-component/@xmldom/xmldom/uuid were previously accepted here too, but are now forced to patched versions via package.json overrides (trivy findings #83-88) and removed from this list — a baselined entry that has disappeared fails the gate on purpose, so don't re-add them without re-verifying the override still resolves.
